title: Deliverance of the Jews
summary: Mordecai and Esther deliver the Jews (Esth 9:1).
description: Mordecai and Esther deliver the Jews (Esth 9:1). The year is the Appendix F figure, stored as printed.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 3: Ussher-Jones (Floyd Nolen Jones): 509 BC (no higher-tier year available).

chronologies.citation: Jones, The Chronology of the Old Testament: A Return to the Basics, 23rd ed. (Master Books, 2026), Appendix F, printed p. 280 (PDF p. 315)
chronologies.note: CONFLICT: Jones prints AM 3496 and 509 BC. A derived check (not stored): 3496 + 509 = 4005, not 4004, against his rule that a BC number added to its AM counterpart yields 4004. Both figures are stored as printed (first-printed rule). Neither was adjusted. The sort uses the printed BC year. Esther and Mordecai have no person records.
